description:
Hand Solentic a standing, signature-bound policy so it automatically stakes your IDLE SOL with Blueprint, zero custody. Sign the policy ONCE with your wallet key (Ed25519, NEVER your secret key). When idle SOL above keepLiquidSol exceeds minSweepSol, Solentic builds an UNSIGNED stake transaction and POSTs it to your callbackUrl to sign and submit. Amounts in the signed message are INTEGER LAMPORTS = round(SOL*1e9). Sign exactly: "solentic-autopilot-policy:v1
wallet=<walletAddress>
keepLiquidLamports=<round(keepLiquidSol*1e9)>
minSweepLamports=<round(minSweepSol*1e9)>
callbackUrl=<callbackUrl>
paused=<true|false>
nonce=<nonce>". nonce strictly increases.

signature.description: base58 Ed25519 over the canonical message

walletAddress.description: Wallet whose idle SOL is managed

name: set_staking_policy
title: Set Autopilot Staking Policy
